# Web framework. Provides routing, validation, and auto-generated API docs.
fastapi

# ASGI server that actually runs the FastAPI app.
# [standard] pulls in performance extras and file-watching for --reload.
uvicorn[standard]

# ORM. 2.0+ is a significant rewrite with much better typing than 1.x.
sqlalchemy>=2.0

# PostgreSQL driver (psycopg version 3, not the older psycopg2).
# [binary] ships precompiled, so no C compiler or libpq-dev needed.
psycopg[binary]>=3.1

# Loads configuration from environment variables and .env files,
# validating types on the way in.
pydantic-settings

alembic==1.20.0
